meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会持续盯住被交给它的 Pull Request，定期查看留言、审查意见和自动检查结果，发现问题就修，直到全部解决才结束。
howto.when: 当用户要求 babysit 或 monitor 某个 PR，或要求持续检查 PR 的评论、审查和 CI 直到问题全部解决时，它就会接管盯守。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR，直到能合并为止。
say.note: 会持续查看评论和 CI，有问题就修。

say.text: 盯着 PR #123 的检查，别停，直到通过。
say.note: 会轮询 CI，失败就修复并重推。

say.text: 还有未解决的 review 吗？守着它清空再告诉我。
say.note: 会检查未解决线程，并等待它们解决。

howto.what_en: It keeps watching the assigned pull request, periodically checking comments, review threads, and CI checks, fixing issues it finds, and only ends once everything actionable is resolved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to babysit or monitor a pull request, or to keep checking comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Keeps checking comments and CI; fixes issues found.

say_en.text: Watch PR #123's checks, keep going until they pass.
say_en.note: Polls CI, fixes failures, and pushes again.

say_en.text: Any unresolved reviews? Stay on it until they're resolved, then report.
say_en.note: Checks threads and waits for them to resolve.
